input.quote: This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce" returned nothing, and the sections where such a covenant would typically sit (§ 10 Confidentiality, § 13 Shared Resources, § 14 Miscellaneous) contain none: the only personnel-related provisions are Commerce One's warranty that its personnel have signed Employee NDA/Invention Agreements (§ 13.5) and the independent contractor clause (§ 14.5), neither of which restricts Corio from hiring or approaching Commerce One personnel. Corio (our party, the licensee/host) is therefore not bound by any restrictive covenant on hiring, which matches our preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer. No redline is needed; if a non-solicit is later introduced via the incorporated Non-Disclosure Agreement, we would hold it to the fallback (mutual, personnel directly involved, 12 months, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire).
